title: Self-Calibrated Subspace Robust PCA for Parameter-Free Removal of Mixed Noise and Line Stripes in Hyperspectral Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.21896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are often corrupted by Gaussian noise, impulses and stripes whose intensities vary across bands. The representative coefficient correlated total variation (RCCTV) model restores HSIs efficiently, but it lacks Gaussian and stripe terms, and its noise-aware extensions require the noise level and a stripe budget to be specified in advance. This article proposes a self-calibrated RCCTV (SC-RCCTV) model, in which the noise parameters are estimated adaptively during the iterations. A band-wise dense term and line-constant column and row stripe terms are introduced into RCCTV. The noise level of each band is initialized by a stripe-invariant median absolute deviation estimator and refined online from the residual, which turns the separation of sparse and dense noise into a band-adaptive Huber loss, and the stripe thresholds follow from a significance test whose false-alarm rate can be predicted analytically. No param

translated_title: 用于高光谱图像无参数去除混合噪声与线状条纹的自校准子空间鲁棒主成分分析
translated_abstract: 高光谱图像（HSIs）常常受到各波段强度不同的高斯噪声、脉冲噪声和条纹的污染。代表性的系数相关全变分（RCCTV）模型能够高效地恢复高光谱图像，但该模型缺少高斯噪声项和条纹项，且其噪声感知的扩展版本需要预先指定噪声水平和条纹预算。本文提出了一种自校准的RCCTV（SC-RCCTV）模型，其中噪声参数在迭代过程中自适应地估计。该模型在RCCTV中引入了逐波段的稠密噪声项以及列方向的行常数条纹项和行方向的列常数条纹项。每个波段的噪声水平由一个对条纹不变的中位数绝对偏差估计器进行初始化，并在迭代中根据残差在线细化，从而将稀疏噪声与稠密噪声的分离转化为波段自适应的Huber损失；条纹阈值则来自一种显著性检验，其虚警率可以通过解析方式预测。无需参数（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出自校准的SC-RCCTV模型，通过在迭代中自适应估计各波段噪声水平和条纹阈值（无需预先设定任何参数），实现了对高光谱图像中强度跨波段变化的混合噪声与线状条纹的有效去除。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-calibrated SC-RCCTV model that adaptively estimates band-wise noise levels and stripe thresholds during iterations, enabling parameter-free removal of mixed noise and line stripes with varying intensities across bands in hyperspectral images.
